description: This file defines the AdminPostEditForm class, which extends ProjectPostForm to create and manage the form used for editing blog posts or project posts in the admin interface. It specifies form fields such as title, subtitle, date, header image, author, slug, text content, tags, media, section, allow comments, and publish status. The form handles different text editors based on content type and includes validation constraints.

classes.name: AdminPostEditForm
classes.description: A form class used in the admin section for editing project or blog posts, extending the ProjectPostForm with additional fields and validation rules.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes and configures the form fields for editing a post, including title, subtitle, date, header image, author, slug, text content with different editors, tags, media, section, and publish options.

methods.name: displayTextEditor
methods.description: Helper method to add the appropriate text editor field (Markdown or HTML) based on the content type.
